title: External Accuracy Packet to Runtime Contract Adapter Boundary
objective: Define and qualify a typed non-kernel runtime adapter boundary that consumes only an already F-GC13-validated and externally source-digest-content-verified project-accuracy view, then materializes coupling_application_accuracy_contract_t without selecting project policy or parsing external evidence files.

required_upstream_attestations: application evidence source digest verified against exact governed source bytes upstream
temporal evidence source digest verified against exact governed source bytes upstream
F-GC13 schema version supported by adapter
mapping: h_app_cm -> coupling_application_accuracy_contract_t%h_app_cm with availability/external qualification asserted only after adapter acceptance
a_temporal -> coupling_application_accuracy_contract_t%a_temporal with availability/external qualification asserted only after adapter acceptance
adapter_contract.fail_closed_output: On any rejected input, return the default unconfigured coupling_application_accuracy_contract_t and diagnostics with materialized=false.
defense_in_depth: require positive supported evidence schema version
require both external source digest content-verification attestations
require distinct positive application and temporal provenance IDs
reuse canonical coupling_application_accuracy_contract_t validity and temporal-budget checks

positive_oracles: HEAD canonicalized fraction path: H_app=8 cm, A_temporal=0.25 -> 2 cm temporal budget
DRAWDOWN canonicalized direct-budget path: H_app=10 cm, A_temporal=0.2 -> 2 cm temporal budget
negative_oracles: application and temporal provenance ID reuse

hard_nonclaims: No real project H_app or A_temporal is qualified by this workunit.
The adapter does not verify external source bytes itself; it requires upstream verification attestations.
The adapter does not parse F-GC13 JSON or any project document.
The adapter does not make project-policy choices.
This is not production SWAP-MODFLOW admission.
F-GC07 through F-GC13 remain closed and are not reopened.
